test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the institute from the given description.

‘The institute was founded on 1 June 1945 with support from the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust. The institute first began functioning within the Cosmic Ray Research Unit on the campus of the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore and moved to Bombay in October that year.'
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Homi J. Bhabha**, who was well-known for his work on the** Indian atomic energy** programme, wrote to the** Sir Dorabji Tata Trust in 1944 **to ask for financial support to build a research institute Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR).
 
• With the construction of research centres in **Ooty and the Kolar gold mines**, **TIFR** rose to prominence in the **1950s** in the field of** cosmic ray** **physics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In Mumbai, India, the **Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR)** is a **public deemed research university** devoted to conducting **fundamental research** in the **natural and social sciences.**
 
• It functions as a **Deemed University** and is overseen by the Indian government's **Department of Atomic Energy**.
 
• It is situated in **Navy Nagar, Colaba, Mumbai,** and has an affiliated campus in** Serilingampally**, close to **Hyderabad**, as well as an** International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS)** campus in **Bangalore.**
 
• Research in the natural sciences, mathematics, biological sciences, and theoretical computer science are** the main areas of focus at TIFR.**
